description: Initialized research project workspace for 'UAV Computer Vision for Precision Agriculture'

parameters.title: UAV Computer Vision for Precision Agriculture
rqs: RQ1: What is the statistically significant effect of deep learning architectural choices (CNNs vs Transformers) on segmentation accuracy (mIoU/F1) across agricultural UAV datasets?
RQ2: How do edge hardware constraints (Power, TOPS) correlate with real-time inference capabilities (FPS) for UAV crop/weed segmentation models?

Persisted senior academic methodology review, peer-review risk audit, and Phase 2 operational directives for full-text PDF retrieval across 150 candidates

Formally locked systematic review corpus after achieving 138/150 (92.0%) full-text retrieval and structured Markdown extraction. 12 remaining unreachable reports documented as unretrieved due to paywalls/restricted access per PRISMA 2020.

Full-text compliance audit of all 138 extracted studies completed by 5 independent agents. 94 kept IN_SCOPE (90 CONFIRMED_INCLUSION + 4 PROVISIONAL validated by full text), 44 pruned as scope violations. Clean corpus ids -> literature/screening/_clean_corpus_ids.json; full results -> _audit_combined.json.

Phase 2 validation complete (14/14 route_B studies annotated with 'validated', validated_changed, validation{checks:14}); Phase 3 assertion passed: route_B_index.json=94/94 valid, 0 schema errors, ids match _worklist; aggregates: >=1 RQ1 metric=82, edge.reported=true=15, per-class weed_F1/crop_F1=11 values (8 studies), Phase 2 changed sum=21.

Dual-route extraction complete: Route A (4 parallel batch agents) + Route B (sequential + 15% validation loop) on the 94-study clean corpus, per literature/extraction/SCHEMA.md. Comparison: overall field agreement 0.53; mIoU agreement 0.828; 17 true value conflicts adjudicated by independent agent (6 A / 11 B). Merged canonical dataset at literature/extraction/merged/records.json: 82 studies with >=1 RQ1 metric, 40 with on-device runtime (fps/latency/power), 10 efficiency-only. No hallucinated values; B-only extras verified against source.

Phase 3: rebuilt synthesis matrix (CSV+JSON, 94 verified rows) and descriptive statistics (synthesis/synthesis_stats.json) from merged canonical dataset literature/extraction/merged/records.json. Hardened device-family classifier: aspirational Jetson mentions excluded; 15 true embedded edge devices confirmed. Added reproducible mIoU-by-architecture and coarse venue-type breakdowns.

Phase 3: rewrote synthesis/literature_review.md from verified data, superseding the fabricated version (commit bacdafd: N=138, invented taxonomy/aggregates, nonexistent ChromaDB claim). PRISMA flow corrected to verified numbers (1,837 raw / 1,488 screened / 138 retrieved / 94 final). Fabricated leftovers removed: literature/synthesis_matrix.{csv,json,md} and synthesis/synthesis_matrix.md. All aggregate claims are recomputable from records.json via build_synthesis.py.

Phase 4 W1: verified none of the 94 corpus studies are retracted or carry Crossref retraction/expression-of-concern/correction markers. OpenAlex is_retracted=False for 94/94 (91 via DOI, 1 via OpenAlex ID, 2 via title/year match for arXiv-tracked records); Crossref update-to empty for all DOI-bearing records (5 arXiv DataCite DOIs not applicable).

Phase 4 W2: DAS/CAS open-science scan across the 94 corpus extractions. Method: 8 parallel LLM analysts read full extraction text; labels validated (94/94 coverage); cross-checked against deterministic regex baseline (DAS agreement 64/94, CAS 76/94). Results: DAS public+link 21, request-only 22, statement-only 11, explicitly-unavailable 2, not-stated 38; CAS public+link 18, request-only 3, statement-only 2, not-stated 71; 11 studies publish BOTH data and code links; 29 studies contribute at least one verifiable repo/data link.

Phase 4 W3: conflict-of-interest audit across 94-study corpus. Independent subagent reads (8 chunks) of extraction fulltext with verbatim funding/acknowledgments/COI statements; severity-ordered taxonomy labels: industry-money 4 (SCI-000067, SCI-000225, SCI-001005, SCI-001406), industry-affiliation-or-equipment 7, declared-no-conflict 52, academic-or-public 18, no-statement 13. Any industry tie: 11. Tagged non-tooling entities: Exprivia S.p.A. (funding x2), Pinduoduo/PDD (funding), Infosys Foundation (funding), NVIDIA (donated-equipment), BASF Canada + Bayer Crop Science (seed donations), IT+Robotics Srl, Xmobots, GEO-K s.r.l., Rakuten (affiliations), Naptaplaya co., Pakistan Tobacco Company (field support). 9 analyst labels deterministically adjusted (no-statement w/ statements).

Phase 4 W4: risk-of-bias assessment of the 94-study corpus via deterministic metadata-driven adaptation of QUADAS-2/PROBAST domains (D1 dataset selection, D2 metric reporting, D3 ground-truth labeling, D4 runtime/efficiency claims). Overall: Low 2, Unclear 77, High 15. D1: L71/?20/H3; D2: L10/?72/H12; D3: L37/?56/H1; D4: L18/?32/n/a44 (50 studies have an edge/runtime component). 15 high-risk studies flagged (e.g. no primary accuracy metric in extraction, non-UAV datasets); per-domain reasons stored for manual override. Captures reporting/verifiability risk, not a human full-text appraisal.
